analyst: The script enters on long_sig or short_sig signals, which are formed from the volume-profile POC band, POC delta imbalance, EMA trend/slope filter, and confirmation candles. A long opens when long_sig is true and the skip window is not active, while a short opens when short_sig is true and the skip window is not active. The stop is the stop_dollars input converted to points by dividing by pv, placed below a long position and above a short position. It also exits when open profit reaches -stop_dollars, uses tp_dollars/pv as the limit target, and can close a position when the skip window begins.
